The '''Kal'Shebbol system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]] was the system's primary [[Planet/Legends|world]], and it was a major trading hub on the [[Trition Trade Route]] that ran through the [[Sector/Legends|sector]]. The Kal'Shebbol system served as the primary system of the Kathol sector when it was inducted into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], as Kal'Shebbol was appointed the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. Control of the Kal'Shebbol system passed to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], and, in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] withdrew the entire sector from the Empire in the wake of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Death/Legends|death]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], establishing his own [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] fiefdom. The Kal'Shebbol system became the nexus of his domain until [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], when the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] launched a [[DarkStryder Campaign|successful operation]] to [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|remove him from power]].

==Description==
The Kal'Shebbol [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located within the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="TEA" /> and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]]. As was common throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the system was named after its principal world. The system was connected to the [[Brolsam system/Legends|Brolsam]] and [[Torize system/Legends|Torize systems]] in the Kathol [[Sector/Legends|sector]],<ref name="tdc" /> and the [[Pergitor system/Legends|Pergitor system]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] via [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]].<ref name="loe">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref> It was also a major port on the [[Trition Trade Route]], which ran through the sector. The system was located close to the border between the Kathol sector and the Minos Cluster.<ref name="tdc" /> [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] traveling from the Kal'Shebbol system took just over nine days to reach [[Pergitor]],<ref>Based on the fact that, in ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', the travel time between Kal'Shebbol and Karideph is 10 days. As the travel time between Karideph and Pergitor is established as 20 hours in ''[[Galaxy Guide 6: Tramp Freighters]]'', subtracting this time from the 10 days figure gives us a time of 9 days, 4 hours for travel between Kal'Shebbol and Pergitor.</ref> eighteen [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] to reach [[Torize]], and a day and six hours to reach [[Brolsam]] using a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|Class 1 hyperdrive]].<ref name="tdc" />

==History==
[[File:Tritiontraderoute.jpg|thumb|left|The Trition Trade Route, showing the Kal'Shebbol system in relation to the rest of the Kathol sector]]
The system's prime world, Kal'Shebbol, was settled by escaped [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]] around [[392 BBY/Legends|392 BBY]]. When the Kathol sector was formally integrated into the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Kal'Shebbol was selected as the sector [[Capital/Legends|capital]] over the planet [[Gandle Ott]], which was located at the end of the Trition Trade Route. Gandle Ott had been settled two hundred [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before Kal'Shebbol and was the first official colony in the sector. However, Kal'Shebbol was appointed as the capital by virtue of the fact that it was closer to Republic [[Realspace/Legends|space]] than Gandle Ott.<ref name="tdc" />

In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the Galactic Republic was dissolved and reformed as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> and the Kal'Shebbol system fell under Imperial control. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] was assigned to oversee the sector, and was [[Imperial Government Complex|headquartered]] on Kal'Shebbol. Under Sarne, free travel to and from the Kal'Shebbol system was prohibited.<ref name="tdc" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> With the fracturing of [[Imperial High Command/Legends|Imperial High Command]] as high ranking officials broke away from the Empire and established their own [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] territories, Moff Sarne quietly withdrew the Kathol sector from Imperial authority and established his own fiefdom. For the next four years, the Kal'Shebbol system was the heart of Sarne's domain, and he kept a number of [[Warship/Legends|warships]] in the system to protect his capital.<ref name="tdc" />

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] initiated a [[DarkStryder Campaign|campaign]] to oust Sarne from power. The Moff had made [[Minos Cluster incursions|incursions]] into the nearby Minos Cluster, gaining victory through the use of [[DarkStryder technology|exotic technology]]. He had been [[Minos Cluster counterattack|repulsed]],<ref name="tdc" /> and a [[New Republic task force (Kal'Shebbol)|task force]] was sent to [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberate]] Kal'Shebbol and end his rule. The task force engaged Sarne's [[Moff Sarne's forces|forces]] in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] around Kal'Shebbol, while a [[Katarn Commandos|commando team]] lowered the [[Planetary shield/Legends|planetary shields]]. The New Republic was victorious&mdash;although Sarne managed to escape the system with the majority of his fleet&mdash;and the Kal'Shebbol system came under New Republic control.<ref name="tsb">{{DarkStryder|adventure=The Saga Begins|book=The DarkStryder Campaign}}</ref> The New Republic installed an [[Elomin/Legends|Elomin]] named [[Monjai]] as [[Governor/Legends|governor]], and expected to deploy a defensive fleet to the system a few months later.<ref name="tdc" />

==Locations==
Kal'Shebbol had a single continent, where the planet's population lived. The world was covered in wide, open plains and rolling hills, and had a breathable [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]] compatible with most [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]-breathing [[Species/Legends|species]]. The planet's conditions were favorable for both [[Farm/Legends|agriculture]] and the grazing of herd animals, such as the native [[chollas]]. Traditionally, the planet had been governed by a system of clan and [[City/Legends|city]]-states, but the social order was overthrown when the Empire took control of the planet, as the new officials cared little for the planet's traditions. The planet was inhabited mainly by Twi'leks and [[Human/Legends|Humans]], but also included large communities of other [[Alien/Legends|alien]] races.<ref name="tdc" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Kal'Shebbol system was created for ''[[The DarkStryder Campaign]]'', a [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook published by [[West End Games]] in [[1995]].<ref name="tdc" /> The system was later included in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''<ref name="TEA" /> and its [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|online companion]], which placed it in grid square M-21.<ref name="Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
